title: Vietnam arrests ONUS-linked suspects in alleged crypto fraud case
summary: Vietnam detained ONUS-linked suspects in an alleged token fraud case as police described price manipulation, false promotions and centralized market control.

title: Australia fines local Binance unit $6.9M over client onboarding failures
summary: An Australian court ordered Binance Australia Derivatives to pay $6.9 million after misclassifying retail clients and exposing them to high-risk crypto products.

title: Bitcoin ETFs log biggest outflows in 3 weeks as Iran war fears rise
summary: US Bitcoin ETFs saw significant outflows of $171 million on Thursday as market participants feared another weekend escalation in the US-Israel conflict with Iran.

summary: Tether has reportedly hired KPMG for its first full independent audit of USDT’s reserves and brought in PwC to help, as the stablecoin giant eyes a multibillion-dollar equity raise.

title: Whales, sharks buy 61,000 BTC in a month amid global uncertainty
summary: Not all whales have been accumulating; two moved tens of millions of dollars to exchanges on March 19 as Bitcoin fell amid an escalation of the Iran conflict.

title: Cathie Wood’s ARK taps Kalshi data to help make investment calls

title: US federal judge temporarily blocks Pentagon's Anthropic ban

title: Lawmakers push another bill to curb prediction market insider trading
summary: The bill proposes to prohibit government officials from using insider information to bet on prediction market contracts, with fines up to double the amount of profits.
